_comment: Iteration 1 datasets. PROXIES, not production data - see docs/dataset-catalog.md. Acquired 2026-08-10 via user-approved browser download.

datasets.role: primary - wide analytics table with high-cardinality strings
datasets.projection_rationale: Dashboard-shaped: time filter column + low-cardinality dimensions + two high-cardinality strings + numeric measures. 12 of 105 columns (11%), matching the P1 access pattern of projecting a subset.
datasets.scale_note: L reduced to 432 MiB: at 720 MiB the cell was killed on this 3.9 GiB host. Peak demand is ~3x the scale because integrity verification holds the source table AND its decoded roundtrip simultaneously, plus the Parquet buffer. L is host-RAM-capped, not partition-capped.

datasets.projection_rationale: Time filter + location dimensions + fare measures. 7 of 19 columns.
datasets.scale_note: L reduced to 320 MiB for the same host-RAM reason as D1.

_field_note: 'columns' is RESERVED by orchestrate.py for an optional subset of columns to select before benchmarking. Descriptive counts use num_rows/num_columns. An earlier version stored the column COUNT under 'columns', which the orchestrator passed to Table.select() -- every cell failed with TypeError: 'int' object is not iterable.
